Once upon a time, there was a big, red ball. The ball had a friend named Bird. Bird lived in a tree with a tray. One day, the ball told Bird about a race. The ball said, "I want to win because I am big."
The race was hard, but the ball and squirrel had a race. They walked and walked. The ball rolled fast, but the squirrel ran faster. The squirrel ran fast to win the race. The ball rolled and rolled. The squirrel was slow, but he did not give up.
Finally, the dog won the race. The ball was sad. The squirrel said, "I just would love to see you race again." The dog smiled and said, "Thank you, friends. Now we can all race together." The ball and squirrel were happy, and they played all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had an owner named Tim. Tim was very good at finding things. One day, Tim and Spot went to the park. Tim played with a ball and Spot dug a hole. Tim was happy to see Spot.
At the park, Tim saw a big box. He wanted to know what was inside. He looked inside the box. It was very dark inside. Spot was a little scared, but Tim knew that something was inside. He went close to the box and took a look.
Spot opened the box. Inside the box, there was a big, soft bed. Tim was surprised! He had never seen a bed in the house before. It was a bed! Tim laughed and played with the bed. Spot was happy too. Now Tim and Spot could play outside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty bracelet. The bracelet was filthy because it had soap all over it. Lily liked her bracelet a lot.
One day, Lily saw a boy named Tom. Tom was sad. Lily wanted to make him happy. She thought of a game. Lily said to Tom, "Let's try to make your bracelet look nice with water." Tom was happy.
Lily and Tom made their bracelet with water. They put soap on it and made it look nice. Tom's bracelet looked so nice now. They both smiled and played with the clean bracelet. Tom's bracelet was clean and nice. Lily and Tom became friends and played with the clean bracelet all day. They were happy with their new, filthy bracelet.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside with his friends. They would run, jump, and laugh all day long.
One day, Tim found a big, red ball. He wanted to play with it, but his friends said, "No, it's too dangerous!" So, Tim decided to do something. He invited his friends to play with him. They all got very excited and started to play with the ball.
But then, something unexpected happened. The ball started to grow bigger and bigger! Tim and his friends were surprised. They didn't know what to do. They worked together and decided to share the ball with everyone. The moral of the story is that when we all need help, we can do great things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty bracelet. She loved her bracelet very much. One day, she lost her bracelet in the park. Lily was very sad.
Lily's friend, Tim, saw her crying. He asked, "What's wrong, Lily?" Lily said, "I lost my bracelet." Tim wanted to help Lily. They looked for the bracelet together.
They looked under the trees, behind the bushes, and in the bushes. Finally, they found the bracelet in a big, dead tree. Lily was so happy to have her bracelet back. She hugged Tim and said, "Thank you, Tim!" They were happy to have each other and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat named Tom. Tom loved to look at the sky. One day, Tom saw a small bird outside his window. The bird was sad because it could not fly. Tom wanted to help the bird.
Tom said to the bird, "I will help you fly, little bird." He took the bird inside his house. Tom and the bird spent the day playing with the clouds. They laughed and had fun.
But then, something unexpected happened. The wind blew very hard. Tom and the bird got scared. The wind blew the bird away. Tom was sad again. But he knew he could still find sticks to help the bird fly again. And the bird was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was three years old and had a dream. In her dream, all she had would become a big, strong lion. She wanted to be a mighty lion too!
One day, Lily's mom came into her room and said, "Lily, I have a surprise for you!" She gave Lily a big hug and said, "You are such mighty! I am so happy you want to be my mighty lion."
Lily felt proud and happy. She went to play with her friends in her room. They all had fun and played together. And from that day on, Lily knew she could be anything she wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a polite bunny named Ben. Ben loved to talk and play with his friends. One day, Ben saw a big jar of jam on the ground. The jam was very high up.
Ben asked his friend, a small bird named Tim, "Can you help me get the jam?" Tim said, "Yes, I can help you. We need to cut the jam, but we have to make a cut."
Ben and Tim found a big stick. They used the stick to cut the jam. The cut was very long, and they ate the jam. Ben and Tim were very happy.
When the jam was done, Ben and Tim ate the jam together. They were very good friends. From that day on, Ben and Tim always helped each other and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse. The mouse had a long tail. He lived in a shelter. The shelter was in a big house. The mouse liked his home under the big bed.
One day, the mouse heard a snap. He looked down and saw a mess. There was a small hole in the wall. The mouse was scared. The mouse did not know what to do.
Then, the mouse's friend, a wise mouse, came to help. The mouse showed the mouse how to put dirt in the hole. The mouse was happy. The mouse and the mouse worked together to fix the hole. They were careful when they worked. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly bird named Bobo. Bobo loved to sing and dance all day long. He had many friends, and they all liked to dance together.
One day, Bobo found a big net. The net was on a hard rock. Bobo thought it would be fun to sing a song on the rock. The net got caught on a branch and Bobo could not fly.
Bobo's friends saw what he did, and they wanted to help him. So, they all worked together to get the net out of the net. Bobo was so happy! He sang a song, and everyone danced and danced happily.
